findings.title: UniPoolerV2._dispatch (verbatim copy) has no non-default-hook guard: an index-4 cutover that skips or reorders setHook leaves the no-op DefaultDispatchHook wired, so every index-4 mint succeeds while accruing zero phUSD mint-debt
findings.primaryWriteUp: CODE-001 (cross-contract chain: three owner writes on three contracts plus replaceDispatcher(4); only the setHook omission fails open). LOCAL-UP-001 adds the BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook-has-no-hookTypeId detail. FAITH-003 is the story-side annotation and is folded in, not filed separately.
findings.secondaryFacet: Fail-LOUD mint outage window: with hook.setDispatcher (plan step 6) and replaceDispatcher (step 8) in separate Ledger txs, index-4 mints through the still-registered BalancerPoolerV2 revert OnlyDispatcher in between; batchMint too if BatchNFTMinterMultiToken.dispatcherIndex == 4. No funds lost. Same mitigation (atomic ordering), so kept inside this finding.
findings.law2Annotation: story-048 mandates a verbatim _dispatch. FAITH-003: the code is faithful; the story is NOT unsafe (owner-omission footgun, not an exploit). A concrete-only guard (constructor-supplied hook, or stored defaultHook compared in _dispatch) is Law-1-sanctioned; if the owner adopts the in-_dispatch guard, record a waiver on the verbatim clause so later Law-2 scans do not flag it.
findings.wontFixDisclosure: Same class as Q-08 96c60b723f (owner wont-fix 2026-06-17). Q-08 triageReason verbatim: 'Owner REJECTED — intentional: BalancerPoolerV2 is LIVE and will not be retrofitted with the hookTypeId guard. The guard asymmetry vs NudgeRatchet is an accepted operational state on a deployed contract (Law-3 owner-trusted).' That rationale (live, no retrofit) does not transfer: UniPoolerV2 is undeployed and story-048 gates its deployment on this audit. New instance on a new contract, not a reopen of Q-08. Sibling open: L-09 563df2e64a (Uniboost). Fixed precedent: M-04 c91bef813d (NudgeRatchet).
findings.recommendation: Concrete-only guard on UniPoolerV2 (store default hook, require(address(hook) != defaultHook)) or add hookTypeId() to the pooler hook. Cutover: setHook before or atomically with replaceDispatcher(4); hook.setDispatcher last or same tx.
findings.severityRationale: Footgun (non-obvious fail-open, competent owner would be surprised), misallocated mint-debt, no third-party trigger or profit. Matches L-09 precedent.

PATTERN-003: venue change warrants re-confirming L-15 rather than silent inheritance. findings.econReweigh: econ-findings.json reweigh.L-15 verdict: NO ESCALATION of L-15 on its own terms (Leg A extraction ~t*A, nearly depth-independent; new venue strengthens the POL-only premise; only external leak is the live V2 fee switch, 0.05% of Leg A volume). Venue depth premise corrected: ~$21.3k/side, not $34k (see DEDUP-20-09). The one genuinely new fact — shared-venue coupling — is this finding.

findings.title: UniPoolerV2 constructor validates only the pair's token set, not pair_ == router.factory().getPair(sUSDS, phUSD); combined with a permissionless, possibly-empty factory pair, the cutover can be decoupled (non-canonical pair) or permanently griefed (dust pre-seed at an arbitrary ratio, MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY lock)
crossRefs: MR-004 (empty-pair seeding window; same as CODE-003; parked verbatim)

facets.impact: pool()/quotePool size s and read reserves from _pair while router executes on factory pair: mis-sized s, wrong quote, LP minted is a different token than pair() reports (rescuable). Floors bound loss.
facets.mitigation: constructor require(factory.getPair(sUSDS, phUSD) == pair_) or cutover-script assertion

facets.impact: Third party createPair + dust mint at skewed ratio before the atomic seed; cutover precondition 0 ('reserves (0,0)') fails forever. Unsafe workaround (relaxing precondition, router add with zero mins) lets griefer arbitrage the protocol seed. No in-repo fund loss today.
facets.mitigation: documented fallback (direct transfer + pair.mint, or pre-arbitrage to target ratio with reserve-ratio assertion); route to /audit-script on the cutover

findings.consolidationNote: Consolidated per orchestrator instruction (shared root: the pooler binds to an unvalidated, externally-creatable pair and the cutover seeds it). The two facets have different attack vectors and only partly overlapping mitigations; flagged for review in case severity-classifier prefers to split.

findings.law3: Facet A on its own is an obvious-misconfiguration (story-faithfulness suppressed it under Law 3); facet B is non-obvious (MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY permanence) -> footgun, in scope.

findings.title: UniPoolerV2.pool/quotePool size the zap from getReserves() without sync(): an unsynced token donation to the pair is absorbed in swap(), stranding non-dust phUSD on the pooler (229 phUSD on a 100k zap after a 0.5% donation) or reverting pending pool() with InsufficientLP, with the donation recoverable via skim() for gas only
crossRefs: MR-001 (same root cause; parked verbatim in manual-review.json per orchestrator rule; subsumed here)

evidence.strand: 1M sUSDS / 1.06M phUSD pool; 5,105.88 sUSDS (0.5%) transferred to pair; pool(100,000, quote*0.99) succeeds, leaves 229.398 phUSD on pooler (dust bound: tens of wei); phUSD only moves via owner rescueERC20
evidence.dos: 2% donation -> pool(a, quoteOut*0.99, quoteLP*0.99) reverts UniPoolerV2__InsufficientLP(48746147894859096248178, 49179748976765704050059); attacker skim()s the donation back -> repeatable for gas
